overview: The Medford High School Building Committee met to select a Construction Manager at Risk, adopt HVAC and solar energy recommendations, and finalize space efficiency adjustments across school facilities. The committee voted to enter contract negotiations with Suffolk, approved an air-to-water heat pump and solar PPA system, and finalized space reductions that lowered the estimated total project cost to approximately $699 million.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the September 22 meeting.

items.title: SMMA Contract Amendment No. 3
items.summary: Approved a $6,600 contract amendment for SMMA to retain a consultant for future radon mitigation system design.

items.title: Construction Manager at Risk Selection
items.summary: Approved entering contract negotiations with top-ranked firm Suffolk to serve as construction manager at risk for the high school project.

items.title: HVAC and Solar System Recommendations
items.summary: Approved advisory group recommendations for an air-to-water heat pump HVAC system and a net-zero solar design utilizing roof and parking canopy photovoltaics via a Power Purchase Agreement.

items.title: High School Space Efficiency Review
items.summary: Approved programmatic space adjustments across early childhood, administrative, vocational, and medical suites, reducing total planned gross building area to 567,877 square feet and lowering the estimated project cost to roughly $699 million.

items.title: Parking and Athletic Field Alternates
items.summary: Approved eliminating field-over-parking structural options from consideration to preserve space for solar canopies and control costs.

items.title: Review of Tabled Space Efficiency Proposals
items.summary: Reviewed previously tabled space proposals, untabling and approving a size reduction for the STEPS classroom to 900 square feet while leaving the remaining items tabled following public comment.
